authority: Codex Feature implementation-milestone decision under Sam's 2026-10-01 clarification that the third digit advances for added implementation; full release fulfillment remains separate.

rule.contractVersion: 0.1.0 establishes the accepted consumer promise; it does not assert implementation fulfillment.
rule.firstPatch: 0.1.1 records the first exact, evidenced implementation snapshot under that promise. This first accounting is retrospective; it does not claim every line was authored after contract acceptance.
rule.laterPatch: Advance the third digit once for each later, independently bounded behavior change at that Feature, bound to an exact source/build/evidence checkpoint. Coalesce related fixes at a checkpoint.
rule.noIncrement: A test rerun, dependency restoration, or receipt alone does not advance a Feature.
rule.contractAndRelease: Further consumer-contract changes use the second digit after their own decision; 1.0.0 remains a separate release-readiness acceptance.
rule.scope: This is a minimal operational patch rule for this decision. Broader cross-system policy remains for Sam and Dot to refine.

checkpoints.decision: First evidenced implementation checkpoint: all 18 Features advance 0.1.0 → 0.1.1.
